title: Parason: Revealing Subtask and Trial Parallelism in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.24658v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling test-time reasoning has substantially improved the problem-solving ability of large language models (LLMs), but standard autoregressive decoding still executes long reasoning traces sequentially, creating severe latency for difficult tasks (up to days and weeks). Parallel reasoning offers a natural remedy. However, prior systems primarily focus on Subtask Parallelism, where the model learns to decompose a high-level task into smaller chunks that can be solved independently. This approach overlooks another pervasive form of parallelism: Trial Parallelism, where multiple speculative attempts explore, verify, and aggregate competing hypotheses in parallel. In this paper, we introduce Parason, which reveals and learns both forms of parallelism in LLM reasoning. translated_title: 帕拉森：揭示大语言模型推理中的子任务与试错并行性
translated_abstract: 扩展测试时推理显著提升了大语言模型（LLMs）的问题解决能力，但标准的自回归解码仍按顺序执行长推理轨迹，导致困难任务产生严重延迟（可能长达数天至数周）。并行推理提供了一种自然的补救措施。然而，先前系统主要关注子任务并行性，即模型学习将高层任务分解为可独立解决的较小块。这种方法忽视了另一种普遍存在的并行形式：试错并行性，即多个推测性尝试并行探索、验证并聚合竞争性假设。在本文中，我们介绍了Parason，它揭示并学习LLM推理中的两种并行性形式。我们的分析表明，试错并行性占据了可并行推理计算的大部分（在HLE中DeepSeek-V4推理步骤中占65.5%），且其重要性日益增加。
tldr: 本文提出Parason系统，首次揭示并同时利用子任务并行性和试错并行性，发现试错并行性占可并行推理计算的大部分，显著提升LLM推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Parason, which reveals and leverages both subtask and trial parallelism in LLM reasoning, finding that trial parallelism accounts for the majority of parallelizable reasoning computation and significantly improves inference efficiency.
